purpose: Gate 2. One or two real declarations per major research epoch. Module coverage alone would not notice an extraction that kept every module but lost declarations inside them, nor a rename that silently orphaned a semantic pointer.
policy: Every entry must resolve: present in formal_graph.json, in the expected module, and where semantic_node is set, actually cited by that node. Any failure is a hard build error.
selection_rule: Names were read out of the built graph, never recalled. Each epoch contributes a definition that other modules depend on (so loss is structural) plus, where one exists, the theorem the semantic layer cites.
